title: EnderFruit
description: Magical fruit that teleports you in the direction you're looking when you eat it.
body:
# ENDERFRUIT
A magical fruit infused with magic of the end dimension.

When consumed, the Enderfruit instantly teleports you a few blocks in the direction you’re facing. Unlike a regular chorus fruit, it doesn’t teleport you randomly — it moves you with precision.

## Crafting Recipe:

1 Chorus Fruit

1 Ender Pearl

![Crafting Recipe: Chorus fruit + Ender pearl](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d438938d45a643d1b9593637d43b2f0429703a7b.png)

 Upon consumption, you'll teleport up to 10 blocks towards the direction you're looking.

###  Uses:
 1. When falling while bridging, you can perform the Ender fruit clutch to get back up
 2. Phase through upto 10 block thick walls which you can't do with an ender pearl or chorus   fruit
 3. Flee from a player or enemy trying to attack you
 4. If you look up and keep eating it, you can even kind of fly!
